verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents a first-party Exports API that creates date-bounded exports across most core data types: customers, screening, screening/monitoring cases, profiles, payment screening cases, transaction monitoring cases/alerts and transactions. Downloads are retrieved via short-lived URLs, and transaction data can be exported as CSV for use outside the platform. However, an open file format is documented only for transactions, and nothing shows that the exports cover all account data or support leaving the service. Missing for 10: documented open formats for every export type, export coverage of configurations, risk-scoring rules and audit trails, an offboarding/account-closure and data-deletion process, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete export.
